A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OUP/COUP research. Their text, equations, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison after matching relocated content.

before.justification: v2 reports original OUP/COUP runtime, optimality-guarantee, and percentage-gap experiments on three solver datasets, including supplementary experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical evaluations in Section 5 and its appendices, including comparisons with other configurators and the doubling-condition experiment.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–2 retain the same selection, sampling, confidence updates, doubling rules, and phase structure. The improved doubling condition already appears in v2; its appendix relocation and dummy-index changes in v3 do not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate minisat, cplex_rcw, and cplex_region with the same configuration-search scenarios. No datasets, application domains, or task requirements are added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain UP and the naive procedure, plus Successive Halving, Hyperband, AC-Band, ICAR, and SPC. Moving the detailed finite-configuration plots into the main text does not change comparator participation.

E3.justification: Utility functions, captimes, phase schedules, evaluation metrics, and baseline budgets remain unchanged. The detailed experimental settings in v2 Appendix D match v3 Appendix C, including the two runtime-quantile settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the exploration-schedule analysis in Figure 4, old-versus-new doubling comparison in Figure 6, and alternate-quantile comparison in v2 Figure 8/v3 Figure 7. No new ablation or supplementary analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Section 5.3 continues to report averages over five seeds with minimum-to-maximum observation bands. Figure 5 merely reverses the words 'minimum' and 'maximum' in its caption; the uncertainty-reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched plots retain identical result data. v2 Figure 7 becomes v3 Figure 1, replacing the redundant earlier display, and v2 Figure 8 becomes v3 Figure 7. No numerical results or performance trends change.

T1.justification: Definitions, lemmas, theorems, proofs, and the doubling-condition derivation are retained. Deferred proofs move from Appendix B to A and the doubling discussion from A to B; notation edits are mathematically equivalent.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about infinite configuration spaces, anytime utilitarian guarantees, and improved efficiency on finite spaces. Wording changes do not expand or narrow these contributions.

C2.justification: v3 adds an explanation to Figure 3: OUP backtracks on cplex_region because a good configuration sampled in phase 5 permits faster optimality certification than in phase 4. v2 displays the same behavior without this explanation. The stated limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5 replaces 'anonymous-repo-link' with the specific drgrhm/coup GitHub repository address, improving documented code-access information. New acknowledgments also identify computational-resource providers. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's availability or contents.

R1.justification: The reference lists and substantive positioning against earlier configuration and bandit methods are unchanged. Rephrasing existing self-citations as 'our previous work' does not introduce new research relationships.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose and citation-style edits, rearranges the Section 3 exposition, reorders appendices, and adds acknowledgments and conference headers. The overall narrative and most wording remain intact.

P2.justification: v2's six-panel appendix Figure 7 replaces its nine-panel main Figure 1 in v3. Other displays are relocated or renumbered, algorithms shift position, and captions and page flow receive limited updates. These are presentation changes to retained evidence.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reproducibility information by replacing the code placeholder with a concrete repository address and clarifies the existing backtracking behavior in Figure 3. Moving the fuller comparison into the main text reduces duplicate presentation while preserving results. These are useful, limited gains; the scientific evidence, proofs, and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
